configurations.name: backend-auth
runtimeArgs: cd backend && set AUTH_REQUIRED=true&& set ALLOW_PUBLIC_SIGNUP=true&& set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./marketingos-auth-demo.db&& set CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3010&& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8010
